preconditions.description: The size of the broom is an integer between 2 and 300,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each ui and vi is an integer between 1 and n inclusive.
preconditions.description: The vertices of the broom are numbered from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: Each xi is a lowercase Latin letter.
preconditions.description: The edges of the broom are marked with lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The first line contains the minimum possible size of the broom after its simplification.
The second line contains the integer p to choose.

postconditions.expression: If there are several suitable p values, the smallest one is printed.
postconditions.description: The output contains the smallest integer p such that the size of the broom is minimized.

invariants.expression: The broom is a rooted tree with vertex 1 as the root.
invariants.description: The broom is a tree with a single root vertex.

invariants.expression: The edges are directed from parent to child.
invariants.description: The edges are directed from the parent vertex to the child vertex.

invariants.expression: The letters on the edges are lowercase Latin letters.
invariants.description: The letters on the edges are lowercase Latin letters.
